queries_run: FormFactor market share gaining OR losing 2026 probe card Technoprobe
FormFactor HBM probe card design win competitor 2026

findings.claim: 10-K 列出探針卡主要對手含 Technoprobe、JEM、MPI、MJC 等；探針卡市場歷來分散；公司承認競爭加劇已導致或可能導致降價、毛利下降或失去市占。
findings.excerpt: We have experienced increased competition in the markets in which we operate, and we expect competition to intensify in the future. Increased competition has resulted in, and in the future may result in, price reductions, reduced gross margins or loss of market share.

findings.claim: 10-K 點名探針卡主要競爭者名單（含 Technoprobe S.p.A、MPI、STAr 等）。
findings.excerpt: Our primary competitors are Japan Electronic Materials Corporation, Korea Instrument Co., Ltd., Micronics Japan Co., Ltd., MPI Corporation, STAr Technologies, Inc., Max One, Technoprobe S.p.A, TSE Co., Ltd., among others.

competitive_share_entrants.note: 搜尋摘要稱 TrendForce 2026-06 報告認為 Technoprobe 可能超越 FormFactor；Deutsche Bank 初評稱 FORM 為 Nvidia GPU 第二家探針卡供應商（二手來源）；公司稱三大 HBM 廠皆有市占提升。這些僅有搜尋摘要、未取得逐字原文，放 clues。

clues.claim: TrendForce 2026-06 報告：Technoprobe 有望超越 FormFactor 成為全球探針卡第一供應商。
clues.source: TrendForce, Probe Card Tech Upgrade & Market Reshaped by AI Packaging-Part 2

clues.claim: Deutsche Bank 首度納入研究，稱 FORM 為 Nvidia 關鍵供應商，Technoprobe 亦為 Nvidia 測試供應商。
Q1 2026 財報電話會議：CEO 稱已獲第二個設計案，延續先前合格認證與首個設計勝出。
clues.source: MarketBeat FormFactor Q1 2026 Earnings Call Transcript
